description: Space-group symmetry (!KPOINTS SYMMETRY=T) on a low-symmetry Si cell (SI2 displaced by 0.05 AA along x, 8 operations with non-lattice translations, so the density is symmetrized in reciprocal space): irreducible k-points plus symmetrized density, density matrices, forces and stress must reproduce the full-mesh run

defaults.@PSIDYN@: OPTIMIZER='DAV' MIXER='VARIATIONAL' SAFEORTHO=T STOP=T EDIFF=1.E-10 MIXTOL=1.E-12

subs.@PSIDYN@: OPTIMIZER='RMM' MIXER='VARIATIONAL' SAFEORTHO=T STOP=T EDIFF=1.E-10 MIXTOL=1.E-12

agree.note: GGA grid aliasing: the full-mesh/irreducible difference falls from 1.0e-6 to 6.9e-7 to 8.5e-8 H/bohr for CDUAL=2,3,4 (2026-10-02)

notes.dedeps:23: guards the strained-spherical-harmonics fix (2026-09-29): the projector stress used G_i d/dG_j instead of its symmetric part, so single k-points were not covariant and the off-diagonal stress from the irreducible wedge was off by 5.7e-5 H
notes.dedeps_trace: stress is not variational; its SCF convergence error (~1e-6 H per component) sets this tolerance
